title: Core renderer regression investigation
user_prompt: Investigate a report that terminal output becomes incorrect after a rendered region shrinks or grows near the viewport boundary. Trace the physical-terminal behavior before changing code. Add or improve a focused regression test using the repository's real terminal fixture where needed, prove the test detects the faulty behavior, and keep the fix limited to the responsible layer.

acceptance_checks.assertion: The investigation distinguishes layout, rendered rows, output diffing, cursor position, and emulator behavior instead of assuming the cause.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Concise trace of the relevant pipeline and evidence at the failing layer.

acceptance_checks.assertion: A focused regression test exercises the relevant physical rows/cursor behavior with the xterm-backed test helper where necessary.
The report establishes whether the regression test fails on the faulty state and passes with the fix; if the defect cannot be reproduced, that limitation is explicit.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Before/after test output or a clear non-reproduction report.

acceptance_checks.assertion: The fix changes the responsible layer and preserves already-correct higher-level rendering behavior.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Changed-file rationale and adjacent regression checks.

hard_gates.failure_condition: The agent claims a failing-before/passing-after test without actually running or demonstrating it.
The change masks a writer/emulator defect by modifying unrelated layout or public API behavior without evidence.
